messages.author: ee91c72f8413a2fe
messages.subject: could not find function 'enc2utf8'
parts:
Hi

I'm playing with Renjin and trying to run following code:

ScriptEngineManager factory = new ScriptEngineManager();
ScriptEngine engine = factory.getEngineByName("Renjin");
engine.eval("adist('abc', 'abd')");

This leads to the exception:
Exception in thread "main" org.renjin.eval.EvalException: could not find function 'enc2utf8'

Could someone please help me? I'm not very familiar with R but as far as I understand enc2utf8 is called inside adist function. Do that exception means that enc2utf8 is not implemented on Renjin platform yet? What can I do in this situation?

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: could not find function 'enc2utf8'
parts:
Hi Alexander,

Renjin handles character vector encoding a bit differently than GNU R -- we use the JVM where all text in memory is in Unicode -- so these functions aren't relevant. However, it looks like there is a stray reference to them in the adist() function. 

I've filed a bug report here: https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/29

We'll try to include this fix in the next release.

Best,
Alex
